question_text: A government employee, Ana, accepted a ₱10,000 cash gift from a supplier in exchange for ensuring a contract was awarded to that supplier. This act is clearly a corrupt practice under RA 3019 (Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act). However, her supervisor argues that it is also a violation of RA 6713. Which of the following best distinguishes the nature of the violation under RA 6713 from that under RA 3019?

options.text: RA 6713 covers only administrative offenses, while RA 3019 covers only criminal offenses.
RA 6713 focuses on ethical standards and conduct, while RA 3019 specifically penalizes corrupt practices like bribery.
RA 6713 applies only to elected officials, while RA 3019 applies to all public officers.
RA 6713 requires a higher burden of proof than RA 3019.
